Any help?

replies.author: awesome_apricot
replies.body:
Do you have a dedicated graphics card? If so:
> Settings (under the Microphone)
> Video
> Video adapter (change it to your dedicated GPU).

Idk otherwise. Maybe change around your sources; ie use global sources, windows, game capture and others.
